XFrame Downloader project art direction: a friendly, thoughtfully designed browser tool that preserves a social post around an exported image or video. The brand metaphor is a frame, context, and a downward download gesture. Restrained, confident visual design. Original artwork only.

Generate the standalone decorative hero artwork for the approved Precision Studio LIGHT identity, not an interface mockup. An exquisite small sculpture made of three overlapping empty rectangular picture frames: one deep teal enamel frame #087F80 in front, one thin ivory frame behind, and one frosted translucent frame offset. A small tactile honey-gold #E6AE45 downward download arrow floats through the middle opening. Frames overlap at elegant slightly different angles, standing on a warm ivory #F7F8F5 studio surface, object centered and large with generous clean margins, warm soft directional studio illumination, refined dimensional materials, understated soft contact shadow. Palette deep ink #122C36, teal, ivory and honey gold. Beautiful contemporary editorial product still life, physically convincing surfaces, calm and precise, front three-quarter view. Background must be a perfectly plain warm ivory #F7F8F5 across the entire image, no environment or horizon, never pure white. No words, letters, logos, UI, screenshots, labels, people, photos inside frames, or extra objects. Landscape 4:3 composition; all artwork well inside the canvas so modest cropping is safe.
